title: Data-rich Garmin watch faces
headline: Your day, at a glance.
description: Compare five digital and instrument-inspired Garmin watch faces, with different ways to balance time and everyday information.
guide: Start with the information you actually use. Compare the preview at watch size, then open the product page to check supported devices and available settings. A dense layout can suit a desk glance; a simpler one may be easier to read while moving.

products.name: Titan Grid
products.reason: A grid-inspired design for a structured dashboard look.

products.name: Midnight Neon — Diagonal Offset
products.reason: A diagonal digital-time layout with neon styling.

products.name: Tactical Flip
products.reason: A digital layout with a tactical visual style.

products.name: Neon Night
products.reason: A neon-styled alternative to a restrained digital dial.

products.name: neon multi data green
products.reason: A green-accented option for fans of multi-data layouts.

title: Analog Garmin watch faces
headline: A familiar face. A different feel.
description: Explore three hand-based Garmin watch faces, from understated charcoal to warm orange and bright yellow accents.
guide: Choose the hands and dial contrast first. Look at how much space remains for your daily information, and check the exact watch model on the product page before installing.

products.name: Ember Gauge
products.reason: An analog pick with an ember-inspired visual identity.

products.name: charcoal jam
products.reason: A charcoal-toned analog option for everyday wear.

products.name: Voltline
products.reason: An analog design with bright yellow hands and markers.

title: Outdoor-inspired Garmin watch faces
headline: Take the mountain with you.
description: Compare Mountain Tactical and Pixel Outdoors: two outdoor-inspired Garmin watch faces with different approaches to landscape styling.
guide: These are watch face designs, not navigation apps. Compare a tactical mountain look with pixel-art scenery, then check device compatibility and the available data fields. Artwork does not imply offline maps or route guidance.

products.name: Mountain Tactical
products.reason: A mountain-themed design with a tactical aesthetic.

products.name: Pixel Outdoors
products.reason: A pixel-art take on an outdoor watch face.
